title: Groundwater Interface Mass Ledger and Diagnostics
objective: Define transaction-scoped interface water accounting and diagnostics in which one accepted exchange amount is assigned with exact opposite sign to SWAP and groundwater, rejected trials are discardable, and diagnostic residuals never become a mass-loss tolerance.
required_semantics: exact opposite SWAP and groundwater assignments
trial ledger separated from committed ledger
rejected trial contributes zero to committed accounting
accepted trial committed at most once
head and flux residual diagnostics remain separate
roundoff residual may be reported but cannot authorize imbalance
hard_nonclaims: no alteration of existing internal transaction mass-tolerance machinery
no groundwater exchange service lifecycle ownership
qualification: no mass tolerance symbol or acceptance branch
